take: CHI announced that it placed goalie Sam Montembeault and forward Oliver Kapanen on injured reserve. We have no numbers on Montembeault. Kapanen has played 12:53 a night in a third-line role and on the second power-play unit, and going by how the coach has used his players, Jake Evans (14:50 a night) is next in line for those minutes. The team around him sits at 3-8-0 and has taken 43% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality), so the squad is already short on quality chances.
